names.name: Mochinut
names.said: Mochi donut, Korean hot dog, one counter.

text.what: A franchise selling mochi donuts and Korean corn dogs that spread rapidly across American strip malls in the 2020s.
text.story: Mochinut built on the pon de ring shape that Mister Donut Japan launched in 2003 and that reached the mainland through Hawaii.
text.today: The newest counter in the trade runs the same play as the oldest: a sweet item and a savoury one from one fryer.
